# iTRAVEL_MAP - Smart Multimodal Travel Planner & Copilot

> iTRAVEL_MAP is an intelligent, AI-powered multimodal trip planning web platform. It leverages Google Gemini AI models to generate customized multi-city travel itineraries, render interactive map routes with Leaflet, optimize transportation and night trains/buses, provide point-of-interest suggestions, and allow cloud saving via Firebase.

For full technical specifications, architecture diagrams, data models, and prompt instructions, refer to [PROJECT_AI_BLUEPRINT.md](./PROJECT_AI_BLUEPRINT.md).

## Core Capabilities
- **Native AI Agent Engine**: Function Calling with real-time Open-Meteo weather forecasts, Haversine multimodal routing calculations, and deep booking links (Google Flights, Skyscanner, Booking.com, Omio).
- **Multi-Turn Conversational Memory**: Full context retention across turns without repetitive queries.
- **Synchronized Map Routing**: Automatic extraction of cities and Leaflet rendering of 3 distinct trip alternatives (Economic, Balanced, Fast/Premium).
- **Zero-Watermark Map Tiles**: OpenStreetMap & Esri World Imagery/Topo tiles.
- **Offline / Cloud Persistence**: Firebase Auth + Cloud Firestore.
